It does not emit AutomaticRestartQueued anywhere in that branch. The original test explicitly searches for AutomaticRestartQueued attempt 2; its missing-event assertion is consistent with this code. This alone does not prove a lost or replenished durable restart budget.

The current tick.rs retains legacy RestartQueued and additionally emits AutomaticRestartQueued with the actual durably returned claim.attempt. On exhaustion it emits AutomaticRestartBudgetExhausted and retains the original operator-visible RestartBudgetExhausted fault.

Current test checks actual canonical durable JSON main.attempts/pending after each crash, health and recovery. It still requires attempts 1,2,3, exactly four spawns, configured maximum 3, original 300-second recovery window and 250/500/1000-ms backoffs. New 249/499/999-ms pre-boundary checks reject early spawning. Automatic events are required exactly once, and the exhaustion tick must contain the exact agent/error fault rather than falsely expecting a clean TickReport.
